featured_title: How to Check for Open Permits Before Buying in Estero FL: 2026 Buyer's Guide
featured_excerpt: Lee County handled building permits for the Village of Estero until 2016, and the Village has handled them since, so an Estero home's permit history can live in two places. Check both eras, compare them to the roof, pool, lanai, and windows you can see, and get the open-permit search back during your inspection period, because Florida law protects you from a prior owner's fines but not from unfinished or unpermitted work.
